name: Slides
title: Slides (presentation deck)
description: Presentation decks as local files: project/deck.json holds the title, slide order, outline and typefaces, and each slide is an HTML file on a 16:9 or 4:3 canvas. Slides can share a deck stylesheet or use inline styles. Edited in a local page with a slide rail, an overview of every slide by section, speaker notes, builds, transitions and a full-screen presenter. Can install a design system and use its colors, type and fonts.
summary: A presentation deck: 16:9 or 4:3 slides with speaker notes, builds and a presenter.
when: The person wants a slide deck: a presentation, pitch deck, report or review deck, lecture or training slides, or a talk with speaker notes, as an editable deck they can view, rearrange, retype and present, or wants to change a folder that holds project/deck.json.
